build_categorical_head: build a CategoricalHead with a specified number of classes and optional label smoothing
build_multilabel_head: build a MultiLabelHead with a specified number of classes and optional label smoothing
predict_categorical: use CategoricalHead predict method to compute class probabilities from input representations
compute_loss_metrics: use loss_and_metrics to compute cross entropy loss and error given inputs and targets
build_head_from_task: use build_head to automatically create a CategoricalHead or MultiLabelHead from a TaskKey
